english: Northeast trade winds carry ships westward across this part of the tropical Atlantic. In 1493, Christopher Columbus led a fleet from the Canary Islands on a more southerly crossing than his first voyage. Steering west-southwest from Hierro, the ships made landfall at Dominica in the Lesser Antilles, opening another route between the islands and Europe.
simp_chinese: 东北信风推动船只向西横越这片热带大西洋。1493年，克里斯托弗·哥伦布率船队从加那利群岛出发，航线比首次远航更靠南。船只从耶罗岛向西南偏西航行，最终抵达小安的列斯群岛的多米尼克，为欧洲与群岛之间开辟了另一条航路。

english: In the tropical Atlantic west of Cape Verde, northeast trade winds carry more than sailing ships across the sea. During northern summer, dust lifted from the Sahara travels westward in a dry layer of air, reaching these distant waters and beyond. Particles settling into the ocean supply iron to its surface waters, far from the desert that produced them.
simp_chinese: 在佛得角以西的热带大西洋，东北信风带过海面的不只有帆船。北半球夏季，撒哈拉扬起的尘埃随干燥气层向西移动，抵达这片遥远海域，甚至飘得更远。尘粒落入海中，为远离沙漠的表层海水带来铁。

english: Northwest of Cape Verde, the trade winds blow west across the Atlantic. Ribeira Grande in the islands became a port of call for ships travelling between Africa, Brazil and the Caribbean. It was also a major centre of the transatlantic trade in enslaved Africans.
simp_chinese: 佛得角西北方，信风横越大西洋向西吹拂。群岛上的里贝拉格兰德成为往来非洲、巴西和加勒比海船只的停靠港，也是跨大西洋贩运被奴役非洲人的重要中心。

english: Between Ascension and St Helena, the South Atlantic separates two remote islands. Portuguese ships reached St Helena in 1502 and used it to replenish supplies on the voyage home from the East Indies. In 1815 Britain stationed a naval garrison on Ascension while Napoleon was held on St Helena.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛与圣赫勒拿之间，南大西洋分隔着两座偏远岛屿。葡萄牙船只于1502年抵达圣赫勒拿，并在从东印度返航时利用它补充物资。1815年拿破仑被囚于圣赫勒拿时，英国在阿森松驻扎海军守备队。

english:
These South Atlantic waters lie near the routes leading to Saint Helena, an isolated island between Africa and South America. Winds and currents shaped the long passages followed by sailing ships returning from the Indian Ocean around the Cape of Good Hope.

Portuguese vessels used Saint Helena as a stopping place in the sixteenth century. In 1659 the English East India Company established a settlement there, supplying ships on their homeward voyages from Asia. The company brought enslaved workers from several regions to support the settlement and its provision grounds.
simp_chinese:
这片南大西洋水域靠近通往圣赫勒拿的航路。圣赫勒拿是位于非洲与南美洲之间的一座孤岛，风和洋流影响着帆船从印度洋绕过好望角返航时的漫长航程。

十六世纪，葡萄牙船只利用圣赫勒拿作为停靠地。1659年，英国东印度公司在岛上建立聚落，为从亚洲返航的船只补充给养。公司从多个地区带来被奴役者，支持岛上的聚落和食物生产。

english: East of Ascension, the South Atlantic opens towards Africa. The island was encountered by Portuguese navigators in the early sixteenth century. In 1815 Britain stationed a naval garrison there while Napoleon was held on St Helena, another remote island to the southeast.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛以东，南大西洋向非洲敞开。葡萄牙航海者于十六世纪初抵达该岛。1815年，拿破仑被囚于东南方另一座偏远岛屿圣赫勒拿时，英国在阿森松驻扎海军守备队。

english: Between St Helena and Ascension, homeward-bound ships crossed the tropical South Atlantic with the long voyage to Europe still ahead. In 1649 the English East India Company ordered its returning vessels to wait for one another at St Helena. Attacks on shipping later led the company to seek an annual warship escort for the fleet from the island.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿与阿森松之间，返航的船只横渡热带南大西洋，前往欧洲的漫长航程仍在前方。1649年，英国东印度公司命令返航船只在圣赫勒拿互相等候。此后由于船只屡遭袭击，公司请求每年派遣一艘军舰护送船队从岛上启程。

english: Off the coast of Kongo and Angola, Atlantic waters connect central Africa with Brazil. From the seventeenth century, enslaved Africans were forcibly carried across this ocean from ports including Loango and Luanda. Farther south, the Benguela Current flows north along the African coast.
simp_chinese: 刚果与安哥拉海岸外，大西洋将中非与巴西连接起来。自十七世纪起，被奴役的非洲人从罗安戈和罗安达等港口被迫横渡大洋。更南方，本格拉洋流沿非洲海岸向北流动。

sources.title: Kersal- et al-2019-Journal of Geophysical Research  Oceans.pdf

english: Southeast of St Helena, the South Atlantic extends towards the southern African coast. Portuguese ships used the remote island to replenish supplies on their return from the East Indies. In 1659 the English East India Company settled St Helena, making it a stopping place for its shipping.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿东南方，南大西洋向非洲南部海岸延伸。葡萄牙船只从东印度返航时利用这座偏远岛屿补充物资。1659年，英国东印度公司在圣赫勒拿定居，使其成为公司船只的停靠地。

english: Southeast of St Helena, the submerged Walvis Ridge stretches across the South Atlantic towards the coast of Namibia. Near its eastern reaches, Valdivia Bank rises to shallow water beside the shipping route northwest of the Cape of Good Hope. The ridge forms a prominent divide on the ocean floor, separating the Angola Basin to the north from the Cape Basin to the south.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿东南方，水下的鲸湾海岭横贯南大西洋，向纳米比亚海岸延伸。海岭东段附近的瓦尔迪维亚浅滩升至浅水处，靠近好望角西北方的航道。这道醒目的海底高地将北面的安哥拉海盆与南面的开普海盆分隔开来。

english: This open South Atlantic sea lies between St Helena and the African coast. Portuguese ships replenished supplies at the island while returning from the East Indies. In 1659 the English East India Company established a settlement on St Helena, providing a stopping place for vessels on the long passage.
simp_chinese: 这片开阔的南大西洋海域位于圣赫勒拿与非洲海岸之间。葡萄牙船只从东印度返航时在岛上补充物资。1659年，英国东印度公司在圣赫勒拿建立定居点，为漫长航程中的船只提供停靠地。

english: Beneath the South Atlantic west of Namibia, Walvis Ridge separates the Angola and Cape basins. To the northwest of these waters rises the eastern flank of Valdivia Bank, a submerged volcanic plateau. Layers of chalk and microscopic marine remains cover ancient basalt flows on the bank, preserving a record that reaches back into the Late Cretaceous.
simp_chinese: 纳米比亚以西的南大西洋海底，鲸湾海岭将安哥拉海盆与开普海盆分开。这片水域西北方隆起的是水下火山高地瓦尔迪维亚浅滩的东翼。白垩与微小海洋生物遗骸覆盖着浅滩古老的玄武岩熔岩流，保存了可追溯至晚白垩世的记录。

english: West of southern Africa, the Cape Basin descends into deep water south of Walvis Ridge. The Benguela system carries relatively cool water northward along the African margin, while farther offshore the basin floor is broken by volcanic seamounts. Among these, Vema rises from the depths to the southwest, its summit lying close beneath the sea.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西，开普海盆在鲸湾海岭南方沉入深海。本格拉海流系统沿非洲大陆边缘向北输送较冷的海水；更远的外海，火山海山打破了盆地海床。其中维马海山在西南方从深处隆起，山顶靠近海面。

english: West of southern Africa, this open sea lies on the broad South Atlantic approaches to St Helena. Portuguese ships used the remote island to replenish supplies on their return from the East Indies. In 1659 the English East India Company established a permanent settlement there.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西的这片开阔海域通向遥远的圣赫勒拿岛。葡萄牙船只从东印度返航时利用岛屿补充物资。1659年，英国东印度公司在那里建立永久定居点。

english: Southeast of St Helena, the open Atlantic lies on the approach from the Cape of Good Hope. In 1652 the Dutch captain Jan van Riebeeck, sailing north from the Cape, feared encountering Prince Rupert near St Helena. The following year the English East India Company advised its ships to avoid the island for fear of attack.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿东南方的开阔大西洋，位于从好望角驶向该岛的途中。1652年，荷兰船长扬·范里贝克从好望角北上时，担心在圣赫勒拿附近遇上鲁珀特亲王。次年，英国东印度公司因担心袭击，建议船只避开该岛。

english: East of St Helena, the South Atlantic opens towards Africa. Portuguese ships used the remote island to replenish supplies while returning from the East Indies. In 1659 the English East India Company established a permanent settlement there, making it a stopping place for the company's ships.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿以东，南大西洋向非洲敞开。葡萄牙船只从东印度返航时利用这座偏远岛屿补充物资。1659年，英国东印度公司在那里建立永久定居点，使其成为公司船只的停靠地。

english: East of St Helena, the deep Angola Basin lies beneath the tropical South Atlantic. Its southern boundary is formed by Walvis Ridge, a submarine rise stretching towards the African margin. In the waters above the basin, the productive zone influenced by circulation off southwestern Africa extends westward towards the Greenwich meridian.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿以东，深邃的安哥拉海盆位于热带南大西洋之下。它的南界是向非洲大陆边缘延伸的鲸湾海岭。海盆上方的水域受到非洲西南部附近海流影响，富饶水域向西一直延伸至格林尼治子午线附近。

english:
This open stretch of the South Atlantic belongs to the waters associated with the Saint Helena Current. Winds and currents shaped the routes sailing ships took across the wide ocean between Africa and South America, especially on voyages to and from the Cape of Good Hope.

Saint Helena, the isolated island that gives the surrounding sea area its name, became a valuable place to replenish ships on long passages. Portuguese navigators reached it in 1502, and in 1659 the English East India Company established a settlement there. The island's provisions and anchorage served ships travelling between Europe and Asia; its colonial society also depended on the labour of enslaved people brought to the island. These are landmarks in the history of the wider sea area, rather than evidence of a settlement in this open-water location.
simp_chinese:
这片南大西洋开阔海域属于圣赫勒拿洋流相关水域。风与洋流影响着帆船穿越非洲和南美洲之间广大洋面的航线，尤其是往返好望角的航程。

海域得名于孤悬洋中的圣赫勒拿岛。葡萄牙航海者于1502年抵达该岛，1659年英国东印度公司在岛上建立定居点。此后，岛上的锚地和补给为往返欧洲与亚洲的船只提供便利；殖民社会也依赖被带到岛上的奴役劳工。这些是周边海域的历史背景，并不意味着这处开阔水域存在定居点。

english: Southeast of St Helena, deep Atlantic water moves across the Angola Basin toward Walvis Ridge. Farther east along the ridge lies the Namib Col, a gap through which deep water can pass between the Angola and Cape basins. The ridge stretches southwest from the African margin, dividing the floors of the two basins beneath the open sea.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿东南方，大西洋深层海水穿过安哥拉海盆，流向鲸湾海岭。海岭更东面的纳米布隘口是一处缺口，深水可从那里在安哥拉海盆与开普海盆之间流动。海岭从非洲大陆边缘向西南延伸，在开阔海面下分隔两座海盆的海床。

english: East of South America, the South Atlantic lies in the belt of the westerly winds. Farther east, ships rounding the Cape of Good Hope entered the Indian Ocean. In 1611 Hendrik Brouwer used southern westerlies to sail east from the Cape before turning north towards Java.
simp_chinese: 南美洲以东的南大西洋位于西风带。更东方，绕过好望角的船只进入印度洋。1611年，亨德里克·布劳威尔利用南方西风从好望角向东航行，再转向北方前往爪哇。

english: South of St Helena, the open Atlantic lies between southern Africa and South America. Portuguese ships used the remote island to replenish supplies on the return from the East Indies. In 1659 the English East India Company established a permanent settlement there for its shipping.
simp_chinese: 圣赫勒拿以南，开阔的大西洋位于非洲南部与南美洲之间。葡萄牙船只从东印度返航时利用这座偏远岛屿补充物资。1659年，英国东印度公司在那里建立永久定居点，为公司船只提供停靠地。

english: Northeast of Tristan da Cunha, Walvis Ridge runs beneath the South Atlantic towards the coast of Namibia. Around 35 degrees south and 5 degrees west, the ridge rises between the deep Cape Basin and the Angola Basin. It belongs to a long chain of volcanic features extending from the vicinity of Tristan across the ocean floor.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛东北方，鲸湾海岭在南大西洋海面下通向纳米比亚海岸。约在南纬35度、西经5度，海岭隆起于深邃的开普海盆与安哥拉海盆之间。它属于一条漫长的火山地貌链，从特里斯坦附近横穿洋底。

english: The South Atlantic separates South America from Africa across a broad ocean basin. Near the Equator surface waters are warm; farther south, conditions increasingly reflect temperate and polar influences. Its circulation turns counter-clockwise, and winds and currents shaped long-distance sailing routes. The Atlantic as a whole is the saltiest major ocean on average, with high surface salinity in subtropical regions where evaporation is strong and rainfall low. Salty Indian Ocean water also enters the South Atlantic through Agulhas leakage around southern Africa, contributing to the wider Atlantic circulation.
simp_chinese: 南大西洋以广阔海盆隔开南美洲与非洲。赤道附近表层水温较高，越往南则越受到温带与极地条件的影响。南大西洋环流呈逆时针方向，风与洋流长期塑造着远洋帆船航路。大西洋整体的平均盐度在主要大洋中最高，副热带地区因蒸发旺盛、降雨较少而具有较高表层盐度。印度洋咸水也经厄加勒斯泄漏绕过非洲南端进入南大西洋，参与更广阔的大西洋环流。

english: Far west of southern Africa, the Alpha banks rise from the floor of the South Atlantic at the southern end of the Walvis Ridge system. Alpha and Alpha II remain hundreds of metres beneath the waves, their summits forming isolated habitats above the surrounding deep water. Splendid alfonsino gather around these banks and the neighboring Beta Bank.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西遥远的南大西洋海底，阿尔法浅滩从鲸湾海岭体系的南端升起。阿尔法和阿尔法二号浅滩的顶部仍在水面数百米之下，在周围的深水中形成孤立的栖息地。金眼鲷聚集于这些浅滩与邻近的贝塔浅滩周围。

english: West of southern Africa, the Benguela Current carries water north along the coast as part of the South Atlantic circulation. Ships rounding the Cape of Good Hope connected this ocean with the Indian Ocean. In 1611 Hendrik Brouwer used southern westerlies beyond the Cape on his way to Java.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西，本格拉洋流沿海岸将海水向北输送，是南大西洋环流的一部分。绕过好望角的船只将这片大洋与印度洋连接起来。1611年，亨德里克·布劳威尔前往爪哇时，在好望角外利用南方西风航行。

sources.title: Kersal- et al-2019-Journal of Geophysical Research  Oceans.pdf

english: West of the Orange River, the South Atlantic opens towards the sea passage around Africa's southern tip. In 1488 Bartolomeu Dias sailed out of sight of the coast after passing the river's latitude. When his expedition next found land, it had passed the Cape of Good Hope; Dias continued east before turning back towards Portugal.
simp_chinese: 奥兰治河以西，南大西洋通向绕过非洲南端的海路。1488年，巴尔托洛梅乌·迪亚士经过河口所在纬度后驶离海岸，直到看不见陆地。船队再次望见陆地时，已经绕过好望角；迪亚士继续东行，随后才掉头返回葡萄牙。

english: East of South America, the southern Atlantic lies in the belt of westerly winds known to sailors as the Roaring Forties. Ships bound for the Cape of Good Hope used these winds on their eastward passage. Farther east lie the Tristan da Cunha islands, named after the Portuguese admiral who reached them in 1506.
simp_chinese: 南美洲以东的南大西洋位于水手称为咆哮西风带的纬度。驶往好望角的船只利用西风向东航行。更东面是特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛，以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅命名。

english: East of the Patagonian shelf, the southwestern Atlantic is stirred by the meeting of the Brazil and Malvinas currents. Cold Malvinas water moves north along the shelf edge, while the warmer Brazil Current flows south before turning offshore. Eddies in the confluence can carry water from the Río de la Plata plume away from the continental shelf.
simp_chinese: 巴塔哥尼亚大陆架以东，巴西洋流与马尔维纳斯洋流的交汇搅动着大西洋西南部。寒冷的马尔维纳斯海水沿陆架边缘北上，温暖的巴西洋流则向南流动，随后转向外海。交汇区的涡旋能够将拉普拉塔河口的羽状水体带离大陆架。

english: Beneath the southwestern Atlantic, cold, dense water formed in the Weddell Sea reaches the Argentine Basin by deep passages east of the Malvinas Escarpment. Part circulates into the basin's interior, while another branch continues north towards the Vema and Hunter channels. The Rio Grande Rise separates this deep basin from the Brazil Basin beyond.
simp_chinese: 在大西洋西南部的深处，威德尔海形成的寒冷稠密海水经马尔维纳斯陡崖以东的深水通道进入阿根廷海盆。一部分水流转入海盆内部，另一支继续北上，驶向维马海峡与亨特海峡。格兰德隆起将这个深海海盆与更北方的巴西海盆分隔开来。

english: The westerlies blow across this open South Atlantic sea in the Roaring Forties. Ships sailing east towards the Cape of Good Hope used these strong winds. The Tristan da Cunha islands farther east were named after the Portuguese admiral who reached them in 1506.
simp_chinese: 西风吹过这片位于咆哮西风带的开阔南大西洋。向东驶往好望角的船只利用这些强风。更东面的特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅命名。

english: East of the Brazil–Malvinas confluence, the open Atlantic can receive water that began its journey in the Indian Ocean. Warm Agulhas rings detach near the southern tip of Africa and drift west across the South Atlantic. Some persist as far as the waters approaching the Brazil Current, carrying heat and salt across the basin.
simp_chinese: 巴西洋流与马尔维纳斯洋流交汇区以东，开阔的大西洋可以接纳来自印度洋的海水。温暖的阿古拉斯环流在非洲南端附近脱离主流，向西漂过南大西洋。有些环流可延续至接近巴西洋流的水域，将热量和盐分带过整个海盆。

english: The Roaring Forties bring strong westerly winds across this open South Atlantic sea. Sailing ships used these winds on eastward voyages towards the Cape of Good Hope. Farther east, the Tristan da Cunha islands were named after the Portuguese admiral who reached them in 1506.
simp_chinese: 咆哮西风带的强劲西风吹过这片开阔的南大西洋。帆船利用这些风向东驶往好望角。更东面的特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅命名。

english: West of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic lies in the westerly winds of the Roaring Forties. Ships used these winds for eastward passages towards the Cape of Good Hope. The islands were named for the Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha, who reached them in 1506.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以西，南大西洋处于咆哮西风带。船只利用西风向东驶往好望角。群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚命名。

english: West of Tristan da Cunha, westerly winds sweep the southern Atlantic. Ships used the Roaring Forties for eastward voyages towards the Cape of Good Hope. The islands were named after Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha, who reached them in 1506; Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以西，西风横扫南大西洋。船只利用咆哮西风带向东驶往好望角。群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅命名；英国于1816年在岛上驻扎守备队。

english: West of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic lies under the strong westerlies known as the Roaring Forties. Ships used the winds on eastward voyages towards the Cape. The islands were named after Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha, who reached them in 1506.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以西的南大西洋受到咆哮西风带的强劲西风吹拂。船只利用这些风向东驶往好望角。群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚命名。

english: Southwest of Tristan da Cunha, the Roaring Forties bring strong westerly winds across the Atlantic. Ships used the winds to sail east towards the Cape of Good Hope. Tristão da Cunha reached the islands that bear his name in 1506; Britain established a garrison there in 1816.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛西南方，咆哮西风带的强劲西风横扫大西洋。船只利用这些风向东驶往好望角。特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达以他命名的群岛；英国于1816年在那里建立守备队。

english: Southwest of Tristan da Cunha, westerly winds sweep the open South Atlantic. Ships used the Roaring Forties to sail east towards the Cape of Good Hope. Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha reached the islands in 1506, and Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛西南方，西风横扫开阔的南大西洋。船只利用咆哮西风带向东驶往好望角。葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达群岛，英国于1816年在那里驻扎守备队。

english: East of Tristan da Cunha, the southern Atlantic opens towards the Cape of Good Hope. Ships used the strong southern westerlies for eastward voyages. The Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha reached the islands in 1506; Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816 while Napoleon was held on St Helena.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以东，南大西洋通向好望角。船只利用南方强劲西风向东航行。葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达群岛；1816年拿破仑被囚于圣赫勒拿时，英国在群岛驻扎守备队。

english: East of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic Current carries water east towards Africa. Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha reached the islands in 1506. Ships later used the southern westerly winds on passages towards the Cape of Good Hope and the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以东，南大西洋洋流将海水向东输往非洲。葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达群岛。后来的船只利用南方西风驶往好望角和印度洋。

english: The open South Atlantic here lies over the southwestern reaches of Walvis Ridge. Great rotating rings of warm, salty water travel west across the Cape Basin from the Agulhas Current, sometimes crossing the ridge near 34 degrees south. Their waters mix with those of the South Atlantic along a route far from the African coast.
simp_chinese: 这里开阔的南大西洋位于鲸湾海岭西南段上方。厄加勒斯洋流形成巨大的温暖咸水涡环，向西穿越开普海盆，有时在南纬34度附近越过海岭。这些水团远离非洲海岸，沿途与南大西洋的海水混合。

english: In the Cape Basin west of southern Africa, eddies carry water far from the Agulhas Current. Some rotate as cyclones and travel west-southwest, while warm Agulhas rings generally move northwest. Their paths cross in the open South Atlantic, carrying water from the Indian Ocean into the wider Benguela circulation.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西的开普海盆中，涡旋将海水从阿古拉斯洋流带往远方。有些气旋式涡旋向西南偏西移动，温暖的阿古拉斯环流则通常向西北漂移。它们的路径在开阔的南大西洋上交错，将印度洋海水带入更广阔的本格拉环流。

english: Off the Río de la Plata, the warm Brazil Current meets the colder Malvinas Current near the edge of the South American shelf. The two currents leave the coast and form a region of intense eddies, carrying contrasting water masses into the Argentine Basin. To the south, part of the Brazil Current overshoots the meeting point before turning back north.
simp_chinese: 拉普拉塔河外海，温暖的巴西暖流与较冷的马尔维纳斯寒流在南美大陆架边缘相遇。两股海流离开海岸后形成涡旋活跃的区域，将性质不同的水团带入阿根廷海盆。部分巴西暖流越过交汇处继续向南，然后转回北方。

english: West of southern Africa, the Vema Seamount rises steeply from the deep floor of the Cape Basin. Its broad, nearly circular base supports a flat summit that comes close to the ocean surface, far offshore from the mouth of the Orange River. Though hidden beneath the Atlantic, the mountain presents a danger to deep-draft vessels crossing these waters.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西，维马海山从开普海盆的深海海床陡然升起。它宽阔的山基近乎圆形，平坦的山顶接近海面，远离奥兰治河口的海岸。虽然藏在大西洋水下，这座山仍会威胁经过此处的深吃水船只。

english: Offshore from the mouth of the Orange River, the Benguela Current carries cool Atlantic water north along southern Africa. Southeasterly winds move surface water away from the coast, drawing colder water up from below. This upwelling nourishes plankton and the shoals of sardine and anchovy that feed larger animals in the southern Benguela.
simp_chinese: 奥兰治河口以外的海域，本格拉洋流沿非洲南部向北输送凉爽的大西洋海水。东南风将表层水推离海岸，使下方较冷的海水上涌。上升流滋养浮游生物，也养活沙丁鱼和凤尾鱼群；这些鱼又成为本格拉南部较大型动物的食物。

english: East of Argentina, the continental slope descends from the Patagonian shelf towards the deep Argentine Basin. Submarine canyons cut the margin, carrying material downslope, while bottom currents shape terraces and waves of sediment. Above them, branches of the Malvinas Current move north along the continental edge.
simp_chinese: 阿根廷以东，大陆坡从巴塔哥尼亚陆架向深邃的阿根廷海盆下降。海底峡谷切入大陆边缘，将物质带向坡下；底层洋流则塑造出台地和波浪状沉积物。在这些地形之上，马尔维纳斯洋流的分支沿大陆边缘北行。

english: Deep in the Argentine Basin, currents move sediment across the plain east of the Patagonian margin. The circulation around the Zapiola Rise meets energetic eddies associated with the Brazil–Malvinas confluence to the northwest. These movements help carry fine particles across the basin, where they accumulate on the submerged rise.
simp_chinese: 在阿根廷海盆深处，洋流将沉积物运过巴塔哥尼亚大陆边缘以东的平原。环绕萨皮奥拉隆起的水流与西北方巴西洋流、马尔维纳斯洋流交汇形成的强劲涡旋相遇。这些水流帮助细小颗粒穿越海盆，沉积在水下的隆起上。

sources.title: Kreps 2024 The Role Of Bottom Meso-Scale Dynamics In Contourite Formation In The Argentine Basin.pdf

english: South of the Rio Grande Rise, the Argentine Basin holds a powerful circulation known as the Zapiola Anticyclone. Water turns counterclockwise around the submerged Zapiola Rise, and the movement reaches from the surface to the deep ocean floor. To the west, the colder Malvinas Current meets the warmer Brazil Current before their waters turn offshore.
simp_chinese: 格兰德隆起以南，阿根廷海盆中有一道强大的环流，称为萨皮奥拉反气旋环流。海水围绕水下的萨皮奥拉隆起逆时针旋转，运动从表层一直延伸到深海海床。西方，寒冷的马尔维纳斯洋流与温暖的巴西洋流相遇，随后海水转向外海。

english: East of the Argentine Basin, the South Atlantic lies near the meeting of waters from different latitudes. The subtropical front separates warmer, saltier water to the north from colder, fresher subantarctic water to the south. Its course bends and shifts as currents and eddies carry water eastward away from the Brazil–Malvinas confluence.
simp_chinese: 阿根廷海盆以东的南大西洋接近不同纬度海水的交会地带。副热带锋将北方较暖、较咸的海水与南方较冷、较淡的亚南极海水分开。洋流与涡旋将海水从巴西暖流和马尔维纳斯寒流的交汇处带向东方，锋面也随之弯曲、移动。

english: In the Roaring Forties, strong westerly winds sweep this remote expanse of the South Atlantic. Sailing ships used them to travel east towards the Cape of Good Hope. Tristan da Cunha farther east was named after the Portuguese admiral who reached the islands in 1506.
simp_chinese: 咆哮西风带的强劲西风横扫这片偏远的南大西洋。帆船利用这些风向东驶往好望角。更东面的特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅命名。

english: West of Tristan da Cunha, westerly winds sweep the South Atlantic in the Roaring Forties. Ships used them to sail east towards the Cape of Good Hope. The islands were named after Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha, who reached them in 1506.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以西，咆哮西风带的西风横扫南大西洋。船只利用这些风向东驶往好望角。群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚命名。

english: Southwest of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic lies in the Roaring Forties, a belt of strong westerly winds. Ships used the winds to sail east towards the Cape. Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha reached the islands in 1506; Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛西南方，南大西洋位于强劲的咆哮西风带。船只利用西风向东驶往好望角。葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达群岛；英国于1816年在那里驻扎守备队。

english:
The South Atlantic links the coasts of South America and Africa with the waters around the Cape of Good Hope. Its broad circulation turns anticlockwise, while winds and currents vary across the open basin.

Portuguese navigators bound for the Indian Ocean developed a route that swung far west into the South Atlantic before turning towards southern Africa. This use of prevailing winds, known as the volta do mar, made the open ocean part of the long connection between Europe and Asia. Crews faced long passages away from land and had to carry sufficient provisions for the journey.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋将南美洲、非洲沿岸与好望角附近的海域连接起来。广阔的洋流环流呈逆时针方向，而海盆各处的风和水流并不相同。

前往印度洋的葡萄牙航海者发展出一条先向西深入南大西洋、再转向非洲南部的路线。这种利用盛行风的航法称为“海上回旋”，使开阔大洋成为欧洲与亚洲漫长航线的一部分。船员需要远离陆地航行，并为旅途携带充足补给。

english: South of the Rio Grande Rise, the Argentine Basin contains deep currents as well as the turbulent waters at its surface. An anticyclonic circulation follows the contours of the ocean floor near the northern part of the basin. Farther south, the great Zapiola sediment rise stands above the surrounding abyssal plain.
simp_chinese: 格兰德隆起以南的阿根廷海盆，既有动荡的表层海水，也有深层洋流。海盆北部附近，一道反气旋环流沿海底地形旋转。更南方，巨大的萨皮奥拉沉积隆起高出周围的深海平原。

english:
The South Atlantic is a deep basin between Africa and South America, broad enough to contain extensive abyssal plains and isolated rises. It forms the southern half of the Atlantic system and opens toward the Southern Ocean. Water from the tropics mixes into this basin from the north, while colder water masses arrive around the southern gateway; the result is an ocean whose surface latitude and deep structure do not tell the same story.

The South Atlantic records the breakup of West Gondwana during the Early Cretaceous. As South America and Africa separated, rifting, volcanism and seafloor spreading opened the basin and left matching stretches of continental margin on opposite sides. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge then follows the spreading boundary, dividing the ocean lengthwise. Secondary ridges and transform faults interrupt its line and divide the deep floor into separate basins, including barriers formed by the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise.

Above this floor, the South Atlantic is dominated by an anti-cyclonic subtropical gyre. Its counter-clockwise circulation gathers South Atlantic Central Water, while Antarctic Intermediate Water forms in the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. North Atlantic Deep Water moves southward beneath the subtropical thermocline. Surface warmth, intermediate salinity and deep return flows therefore connect tropical conditions, southern polar influences and the geological basin into one system.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋是非洲与南美洲之间的深邃海盆，广阔到足以容纳大面积深海平原和孤立海隆。它构成大西洋体系的南半部，并向南大洋敞开。来自热带的海水从北方进入这一海盆，较冷的水团则经南部通道到来，因此表层纬度与深层结构呈现出不同的海洋面貌。

南大西洋记录着西冈瓦纳在早白垩世的裂解。南美洲与非洲分离时，裂谷、火山活动与海底扩张共同打开海盆，并在两侧留下彼此对应的陆缘。如今的大西洋中脊沿着扩张边界延伸，纵向分割洋盆；次级海岭与转换断层打断中脊，又把深海海底分成若干海盆，沃维斯海岭和里奥格兰德海隆也是其中的重要障碍。

在这片洋底之上，南大西洋主要由反气旋式副热带环流控制。逆时针流动汇聚了南大西洋中央水，南极中层水则在德雷克海峡和福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层形成。北大西洋深层水从表层暖流下方向南流动。表层暖水、中层含盐水与深层回流由此把热带环境、南极影响和地质海盆连成一体。

english: West of Gough Island, the South Atlantic lies in the path of the westerly winds. Sediments recovered from these latitudes preserve traces of dust carried across the ocean. The island to the east appeared on early charts under the name of the Portuguese captain Gonçalo Álvares; in 1732 it was sighted again by Charles Gough.
simp_chinese: 在戈夫岛以西，南大西洋处于西风的路径上。这一纬度的海底沉积物保存着横越大洋的尘埃痕迹。东面的岛屿在早期海图上以葡萄牙船长贡萨洛·阿尔瓦雷斯的名字标示；1732年，查尔斯·戈夫再次望见了它。

english:
The South Atlantic occupies the lower section of the Atlantic’s elongated basin, reaching from the equatorial divide toward the southern ocean. Africa lies to the east and South America to the west. Unlike a narrow strait, this is a broad area of open water with room for several deep basins, long ridges and currents whose paths cross much of the hemisphere.

Geologically, the basin formed as West Gondwana broke apart in the Early Cretaceous. Seafloor spreading separated South America and Africa, while the Mid-Atlantic Ridge became the boundary between their plates. The ridge divides the Atlantic lengthwise, but it is not a single unbroken wall: transform faults cross it, and secondary ridges delimit basins on either side. The Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise project across the South Atlantic floor and obstruct currents. These features create deep passages and partial barriers even where the surface seems continuous.

The great subtropical circulation covers this structure with a broad, anti-cyclonic gyre. South Atlantic water turns counter-clockwise under the influence of the Coriolis effect. South Atlantic Central Water belongs to this upper system, while Antarctic Intermediate Water is formed farther south near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. Beneath the thermocline, North Atlantic Deep Water continues southward. The southern basin thus links equatorial waters, southern origin regions and deep return flows within one large oceanic circuit.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋位于大西洋狭长海盆的下半部，从赤道分界延伸至南大洋。非洲在东方，南美洲在西方。这里并非狭窄水道，而是一片开阔水域，足以容纳多个深海盆地、绵长海岭以及贯穿广阔区域的洋流。

从地质上看，这一海盆在早白垩世随西冈瓦纳裂解而形成。海底扩张使南美洲与非洲逐渐分离，大西洋中脊成为两大陆板块的边界。中脊纵向分割大西洋，却并非一道完整不断的墙：转换断层横切其走向，次级海岭又把两侧分成数个海盆。沃维斯海岭与里奥格兰德海隆伸入南大西洋洋底，阻挡海水流动。这些地形形成深水通道和局部屏障，即使海面看上去连续不变。

巨大的副热带环流覆盖着这套海底结构。受科里奥利效应影响，南大西洋海水呈逆时针运动。南大西洋中央水属于上层系统，南极中层水则在更南方的德雷克海峡与福克兰群岛附近形成。北大西洋深层水在温跃层下方继续南下。赤道海水、南方水团由来与深层回流因此汇入同一套大洋循环。

english:
The South Atlantic forms a broad maritime link between South America and Africa and opens toward the ocean surrounding Antarctica. Its history as a route is tied to the recognition that the Atlantic and Indian oceans meet beyond the Cape of Good Hope. Vasco da Gama demonstrated this connection in 1498, and ocean currents soon became part of the practical geography of European voyages into the Indian Ocean.

At the surface, the South Atlantic is dominated by an anti-cyclonic subtropical gyre. Coriolis deflection gives the circulation a counter-clockwise direction. South Atlantic Central Water originates in this gyre, whose moving surface is partly masked by an Ekman layer produced by wind. Pedro Álvares Cabral’s westward contact with Brazil in 1500 shows how the gyre could affect an India-bound fleet. Indian Ocean water also reaches the South Atlantic through Agulhas leakage and rings, making the basin’s circulation more complicated than a closed loop.

The deep seabed adds another system of passages and constraints. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge divides the ocean lengthwise and is cut by transform faults through which deep water can move. West Gondwana’s Early Cretaceous breakup created the basin, while the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise then obstruct some deeper currents. North Atlantic Deep Water flows south beneath the subtropical thermocline. Navigators saw a route across the sea; beneath them lay a layered exchange of central, intermediate and deep waters.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋在南北美洲与非洲之间形成宽阔的海上联系，并向环绕南极洲的海洋敞开。它能被视作航路，与人们认识到大西洋和印度洋在好望角之外相通密切相关。1498年，瓦斯科·达·伽马证实了这条联系，此后洋流逐渐成为欧洲远航印度洋时必须理解的实际地理条件。

海面上，南大西洋主要由反气旋式副热带环流控制。科里奥利偏转使海水呈逆时针流动。南大西洋中央水形成于这一环流，其表层又被风形成的埃克曼层部分遮蔽。1500年，佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔向西抵达巴西，显示出该环流会影响原本驶往印度的船队。印度洋海水还通过阿古拉斯泄漏与涡环进入南大西洋，使这里的循环远比封闭环路复杂。

深邃洋底又增加了通道与限制。大西洋中脊纵向分割海洋，并被转换断层切断，深层海水可经这些断层流动。西冈瓦纳在早白垩世裂解，形成了这一海盆；沃维斯海岭和里奥格兰德海隆如今阻挡部分深流。北大西洋深层水在副热带温跃层下方向南运动。航海者看到的是跨洋航路，水面之下则是中央水、中层水与深层水的层叠交换。

english: East of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic Current carries water towards southern Africa. Tristão da Cunha reached the islands that bear his name in 1506 while sailing towards the Cape of Good Hope. Later ships used southern westerly winds on passages to the Cape and the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛以东，南大西洋洋流将海水输向非洲南部。特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年驶往好望角途中抵达以他命名的群岛。后来的船只利用南方西风驶往好望角和印度洋。

english:
The South Atlantic floor preserves the break-up of western Gondwana. South America and Africa once formed one landmass; during the Early Cretaceous they began to split through rifting, volcanic activity and seafloor spreading. The fit of their opposing coastlines was observed on early maps, although later reconstructions showed that deformation zones and internal rifts complicated the apparently simple join. Matching continental margins remain a visible record of that separation.

The Mid-Atlantic Ridge marks the spreading boundary between the later South American and African plates. It runs the length of the Atlantic and divides the ocean into two long halves. Transform faults cut across the ridge, while secondary ridges separate the deep basins within each half. In the South Atlantic, the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise form major obstacles to water movement. These ridges and fracture zones turn the seafloor into a series of linked barriers, passages and enclosed depths.

At the surface, the anti-cyclonic subtropical gyre turns counter-clockwise. South Atlantic Central Water originates within that circulation, while Antarctic Intermediate Water forms in the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. North Atlantic Deep Water moves south below the thermocline. Together, the ancient continental split, present-day spreading and layered ocean circulation give the basin a history that stretches from the formation of its margins to the movement of water across them.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋洋底保存着西冈瓦纳裂解的记录。南美洲与非洲曾经连为一体；早白垩世时，裂谷作用、火山活动与海底扩张使它们开始分开。早期地图已经注意到两块大陆海岸线的吻合，后来的重建则表明海岸变形带与陆内裂谷使这一看似简单的拼合更复杂。彼此对应的陆缘至今记录着那次分离。

大西洋中脊标示着后世南美洲板块与非洲板块的扩张边界，沿大西洋纵向延伸，把海洋分成两半。转换断层横切中脊，次级海岭又分隔各半部内部的深海盆地。在南大西洋，沃维斯海岭和里奥格兰德海隆成为海水运动的重要障碍。这些海岭与断裂带把洋底组织成相互连通的屏障、通道和封闭深水区。

海面上，反气旋式副热带环流呈逆时针流动。南大西洋中央水在这一循环中形成，南极中层水则在德雷克海峡与福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层形成。北大西洋深层水在温跃层下方南下。古老的大陆分离、当时的海底扩张与分层海洋环流共同赋予这一海盆漫长历史。

english:
The South Atlantic reaches toward the circumpolar ocean and exchanges water with it around southern South America. The Drake Passage is a crucial opening in this geography. About fifty million years ago, changes in the relative motion of the South American and Antarctic plates began to open the passage; a shallow gateway appeared first, and a deeper seaway developed between thirty-four and thirty million years ago. The growing connection accompanied climatic cooling and the expansion of the Antarctic ice sheet.

In the later ocean, Antarctic Intermediate Water originates in the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. South Atlantic Central Water comes from the southern subtropical gyre, and both receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean. North Atlantic Deep Water flows southward beneath the subtropical thermocline. These water masses make the southern Atlantic a meeting place for tropical, subpolar and deep origins rather than an isolated basin.

The physical route around the south also passed through bodies of water shaped by earlier continental separation. West Gondwana broke apart in the Early Cretaceous, opening the South Atlantic between South America and Africa. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge continues to mark that spreading boundary, while the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise obstruct currents. The Drake Passage completes a wider system in which seabed structure, winds and layered circulation determine how the Atlantic connects with the rest of the world ocean.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋向环极海洋延伸，并在南美洲以南与那片海域交换水体。德雷克海峡是这一地理格局中的关键开口。约五千万年前，南美洲板块与南极板块相对运动发生变化，海峡开始打开；先是出现浅水通道，三千四百万至三千万年前又形成更深的海道。这一联系不断扩大，同时伴随气候转冷和南极冰盖扩张。

后世海洋中，南极中层水在德雷克海峡与福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层形成。南大西洋中央水来自南副热带环流，二者也都获得部分印度洋水的贡献。北大西洋深层水在副热带温跃层下方向南流动。不同水团使南大西洋成为热带、亚极地与深层水源交汇之处，而非孤立海盆。

南部绕行路线也受早期大陆分离形成的水域影响。早白垩世，西冈瓦纳裂解，南美洲与非洲之间打开南大西洋。大西洋中脊仍标示着那条扩张边界，沃维斯海岭与里奥格兰德海隆则阻挡洋流。德雷克海峡补全了更大的系统，海底结构、风与分层环流共同决定大西洋如何连接世界海洋。

english: Off the Patagonian coast, the Malvinas Current follows the edge of the continental shelf northwards. It branches from the Antarctic Circumpolar Current after the latter passes through Drake Passage, bringing cold, relatively fresh water into the southwestern Atlantic. Farther north, near the Río de la Plata, it encounters the southward-flowing Brazil Current.
simp_chinese: 巴塔哥尼亚外海，马尔维纳斯洋流沿大陆架边缘向北流动。南极绕极流穿过德雷克海峡后，一支水流从中分出，形成这道洋流，将寒冷、盐度较低的海水带入大西洋西南部。更北面的拉普拉塔河口附近，它与南下的巴西洋流相遇。

english:
The southern South Atlantic is both part of the basin’s subtropical circulation and a route for water returning from the North Atlantic. Warm surface movement and cold deep movement occupy different depths across much of the same ocean. This layered structure matters because a current visible at the surface cannot reveal the full path of water below it.

The South Atlantic Gyre is anti-cyclonic and turns counter-clockwise. South Atlantic Central Water originates in this gyre, while Antarctic Intermediate Water forms in the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. Both currents receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean. North Atlantic Deep Water then flows southward beneath the subtropical thermocline, giving the southern Atlantic a key role in the meridional overturning circulation. The water moving south at depth carries the signature of distant northern origin regions.

That circulation crosses a seabed formed by the breakup of West Gondwana in the Early Cretaceous. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge divides the basin lengthwise; transverse ridges divide it into smaller deep basins; and the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise obstruct currents. Major transform faults allow bottom water to pass through the ridge at particular places. Surface winds, subsurface exchange and the submarine barriers therefore operate together. The southern waters are not merely the warm outer edge of the basin but a junction where upper and deep branches of the Atlantic system overlap.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋南部既属于海盆的副热带环流，又是北大西洋回流海水经过的路线。暖水在表层运动，冷水在深处移动，两者覆盖着大片相同的海洋。这种分层结构很重要，因为表层可见的洋流无法展示下方海水的完整路径。

南大西洋环流为反气旋式，呈逆时针方向流动。南大西洋中央水在这一环流中形成，南极中层水则在德雷克海峡和福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层形成，两者都获得部分印度洋水贡献。随后，北大西洋深层水在副热带温跃层下方向南流动，使南大西洋在经向翻转环流中占据关键位置。深处的南下海水携带遥远北方源区的特征。

这一循环穿过由早白垩世西冈瓦纳裂解形成的洋底。大西洋中脊纵向分割海盆，横向海岭又把它划为较小深盆，沃维斯海岭与里奥格兰德海隆也会阻挡洋流；主要转换断层让底层水在特定位置穿过中脊。表层风、次表层交换与海底屏障由此共同作用。南部海域不仅是海盆的暖水外缘，更是大西洋上层与深层支流重叠的交汇处。

english: In the Argentine Basin, a vast mound of sediment lies hidden beneath the South Atlantic. The Zapiola Rise stretches east and west along roughly 45 degrees south, its crest still nearly five kilometres below the surface. Deep currents circulate around this elevation, shaping the sediment into waves on the ocean floor.
simp_chinese: 阿根廷海盆中，一座巨大的沉积物隆起隐没在南大西洋之下。萨皮奥拉隆起沿南纬约45度东西延伸，顶部仍在海面以下近五公里。深层洋流环绕这片高地，将海底沉积物塑造成波浪状。

english:
The South Atlantic’s warm-water gyre turns counter-clockwise between South America and Africa. It is an anti-cyclonic circulation that dominates the subtropical part of the basin and gives surface water a broad, looping path. The gyre carries South Atlantic Central Water, and the Coriolis effect is the reason its direction is opposite to the clockwise movement of the corresponding northern gyre.

This upper circulation is only one layer of the ocean. Antarctic Intermediate Water originates in the circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands, while both it and the subtractropical system receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean. North Atlantic Deep Water flows southward beneath the subtropical thermocline. These inputs place the South Atlantic within a global exchange of upper, intermediate and deep water, connecting tropical warmth, southern cold origins and distant northern waters.

The seabed beneath the gyre also shapes that exchange. West Gondwana broke up in the Early Cretaceous to form the South Atlantic, and the Mid-Atlantic Ridge then marks the South American–African plate boundary. Secondary ridges divide the deep floor, while the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise form obstacles to currents. Transform faults interrupt the ridge and create passages for bottom water. The basin therefore joins a warm rotating surface to a deeper system of basins and barriers.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋暖水环流在南美洲与非洲之间逆时针运转。它是控制海盆副热带区域的反气旋式环流，使表层海水沿一条宽阔的循环路径流动。南大西洋中央水随这一环流移动；由于科里奥利效应，它的方向与北半球对应环流的顺时针运动相反。

上层循环只是海洋的一个层次。南极中层水在德雷克海峡和福克兰群岛附近的环极海域形成，它与副热带系统都获得部分印度洋水贡献。北大西洋深层水在副热带温跃层下方向南流动。这些由来使南大西洋加入上层、中层与深层海水的全球交换，把热带暖水、南方冷水源与遥远的北方水团联系起来。

环流下方的洋底同样塑造着这种交换。早白垩世西冈瓦纳裂解形成南大西洋，大西洋中脊如今标示南美洲板块与非洲板块的边界。次级海岭分割深海海底，沃维斯海岭和里奥格兰德海隆阻挡洋流，转换断层则打断中脊，为底层水提供通道。暖水旋转的表层与由海盆和屏障组成的深层体系因此结合在同一片海域。

english: In the Argentine Basin, a vast deposit of sediment forms the Zapiola Rise to the southwest. The ocean circulates around this submerged mound in a broad anticlockwise gyre reaching from the surface to the seabed. Its deep currents are strong enough to influence how sediment gathers on the rise, beneath the South Atlantic's wind-driven waters.
simp_chinese: 阿根廷海盆中，巨大的沉积物堆积在西南方形成萨皮奥拉隆起。海水从表层到海床围绕这座水下丘陵作宽广的逆时针旋转。深层海流足以影响沉积物在隆起上的聚集，其上则是受南大西洋风力驱动的海水。

english:
Antarctic Intermediate Water enters the South Atlantic from the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. It is one of several water masses that meet in the southern basin. South Atlantic Central Water originates in the anti-cyclonic subtropical gyre, and both systems receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean. North Atlantic Deep Water also passes southward beneath the subtropical thermocline. The result is a vertical exchange between warm upper water, cooler intermediate water and a deep return flow.

The Drake Passage itself is a geological gateway. Around fifty million years ago, changes in the relative motion of South America and Antarctica began opening it. Small ocean basins first formed and a shallow gateway appeared; a deeper seaway developed between thirty-four and thirty million years ago. That transition coincided with climatic deterioration and the growth of the Antarctic ice sheet.

The South Atlantic basin was formed still earlier by the Early Cretaceous breakup of West Gondwana. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge then divides the basin lengthwise and is interrupted by major transform faults. Secondary ridges form smaller deep basins, while the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise obstruct currents. Salty Indian Ocean water enters through Agulhas leakage and rings. Thus intermediate water from the far south moves through a basin whose submerged ridges, deep passages and long history of opening continue to shape Atlantic circulation.
simp_chinese:
南极中层水从德雷克海峡和福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层进入南大西洋。它是南部海盆交汇的若干水团之一。南大西洋中央水在反气旋式副热带环流中形成，两个系统都获得部分印度洋水的贡献。北大西洋深层水也在副热带温跃层下方向南通过。表层暖水、较冷中层水与深层回流由此形成垂直交换。

德雷克海峡本身是一处地质门户。约五千万年前，南美洲与南极洲的相对运动发生变化，海峡开始打开。最初形成小海盆和浅水通道，三千四百万至三千万年前又出现更深海道。这一转变伴随气候恶化与南极冰盖扩张。

南大西洋海盆形成得更早，源于早白垩世西冈瓦纳裂解。大西洋中脊如今纵向分割海盆，并被主要转换断层切断。次级海岭形成较小深盆，沃维斯海岭和里奥格兰德海隆阻挡洋流。含盐印度洋海水通过阿古拉斯泄漏与涡环进入。从极南方到来的中层水因而穿行于一个由水下海岭、深水通道和漫长开口历史塑造的海盆。

english:
Surface warmth and cold water from the far south overlap in the South Atlantic. The subtropical gyre is anti-cyclonic and turns counter-clockwise, carrying South Atlantic Central Water across the broad basin between South America and Africa. Antarctic Intermediate Water forms in the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands and adds a cooler intermediate layer. Both systems receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean, and North Atlantic Deep Water travels south below the subtropical thermocline.

These water masses interact with a seabed divided by major ridges. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge follows the spreading boundary between the South American and African plates and separates eastern and western basins. Its long course is interrupted by transform faults, including the Romanche and Gibbs fracture zones, through which bottom water can move. Secondary transverse ridges divide the floor further, while the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise form substantial barriers to currents.

Geologically, the South Atlantic opened when West Gondwana broke apart in the Early Cretaceous. The separation of South America and Africa left matching continental margins and created the basin then crossed by layered water masses. Surface winds drive the gyre, the Ekman layer partly masks its deeper motion, and cold intermediate water enters near the southern gateway. Together these layers make the South Atlantic a meeting place of tropical circulation, polar origin water and deep Atlantic return flow.
simp_chinese:
表层暖水与来自极南方的冷水在南大西洋重叠。副热带环流为反气旋式，呈逆时针方向，把南大西洋中央水带过南美洲与非洲之间的广阔海盆。南极中层水形成于德雷克海峡和福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层，加入较冷的中层水。两套系统都获得部分印度洋水，北大西洋深层水则在副热带温跃层下方向南流动。

这些水团与由大型海岭分割的洋底相互作用。大西洋中脊沿南美洲板块与非洲板块的扩张边界延伸，分隔东西两侧海盆。绵长中脊被转换断层切断，罗曼什和吉布斯断裂带使底层水得以通过。次级横向海岭继续分割洋底，沃维斯海岭与里奥格兰德海隆则成为阻挡洋流的显著障碍。

从地质上看，早白垩世西冈瓦纳裂解使南大西洋打开。南美洲和非洲的分离留下彼此对应的陆缘，并形成如今由分层水团穿行的海盆。表层风驱动副热带环流，埃克曼层部分遮蔽更深运动，冷中层水从南部门户进入。热带循环、极地水源和深层大西洋回流在这些层次中相会。

english: In the open Atlantic southwest of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic Current carries water east from the meeting of the Brazil and Falkland currents. Their confluence broadens into a band of contrasting temperatures near 30 degrees west. Below the surface, Antarctic Intermediate Water spreads northward from the Drake Passage into the South Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 在特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛西南方的开阔海面上，南大西洋洋流将巴西暖流与福克兰寒流交汇的海水向东输送。两股洋流的汇合处在西经30度附近展开，形成水温相异的宽阔地带。海面之下，南极中层水从德雷克海峡向北扩散，进入南大西洋。

english:
The South Atlantic communicates with the Indian Ocean in the southeast and toward the Pacific in the southwest, while also joining the circulation around Antarctica. Vasco da Gama demonstrated the Indian Ocean connection in 1498 by sailing around the Cape of Good Hope. The crossing of Pedro Álvares Cabral’s India-bound fleet to Brazil in 1500 showed that reaching the intended ocean could depend on the South Atlantic Gyre rather than a straight course.

That gyre is anti-cyclonic and turns counter-clockwise. South Atlantic Central Water is produced within it. Antarctic Intermediate Water originates in the upper circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands, while both this water and the subtropical system receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean. North Atlantic Deep Water flows south beneath the subtropical thermocline. The South Atlantic therefore connects its own continental shores to distant ocean basins through surface, intermediate and deep layers.

The geological connections are just as important. West Gondwana broke apart in the Early Cretaceous to form the South Atlantic. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge then divides the basin lengthwise, with transform faults and secondary ridges breaking it into separate deep basins. The Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise obstruct currents, and the opening of the Drake Passage established a deep southern gateway. Winds, moving water and submerged barriers together make this a junction between the Atlantic, Indian and circumpolar oceans.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋向东南连接印度洋，向西南通往太平洋，同时也加入环绕南极洲的海洋循环。1498年，瓦斯科·达·伽马绕过好望角，证实了与印度洋的联系。1500年，佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔原定前往印度的船队抵达巴西，显示出到达目标海洋有时取决于南大西洋环流，而非一条直线航路。

这一环流为反气旋式，呈逆时针方向。南大西洋中央水在其中形成。南极中层水来自德雷克海峡和福克兰群岛附近的环极海域上层，它与副热带系统都获得部分印度洋水。北大西洋深层水在副热带温跃层下方向南流动。南大西洋因而通过表层、中层和深层，把自身沿岸与远方海洋连接起来。

地质联系同样重要。早白垩世西冈瓦纳裂解形成南大西洋。大西洋中脊如今纵向分割海盆，转换断层和次级海岭又把它分成多个深海盆地。沃维斯海岭与里奥格兰德海隆阻挡洋流，德雷克海峡的打开则建立了深邃的南部通道。风、流动的海水与水下屏障共同使这里成为大西洋、印度洋和环极海洋的交汇处。

english: Southwest of Tristan da Cunha, the South Atlantic lies in the Roaring Forties, a belt of strong westerly winds. Ships used the winds to sail east towards the Cape. Tristão da Cunha reached the islands in 1506; Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛西南方的南大西洋位于强劲的咆哮西风带。船只利用西风向东驶往好望角。特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达群岛；英国于1816年在那里驻扎守备队。

english:
The open waters of the South Atlantic lie in the basin between Africa and South America. From the age of oceanic exploration, this sea carried expanding trade and the violence of the slave traffic. Columbus reached the Americas in 1492, and Vasco da Gama reached India in 1498 by sailing around the Cape of Good Hope. In 1500, Pedro Álvares Cabral’s expedition to India was carried by the South Atlantic Gyre to Brazil. These voyages opened routes that joined Europe, Africa and the Americas.

The basin around those routes had formed during the Early Cretaceous breakup of West Gondwana. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge then follows the spreading boundary between the South American and African plates, dividing the deep ocean into eastern and western halves. Secondary ridges separate its basins, while the Walvis Ridge and Rio Grande Rise obstruct currents. Transform faults cut through the main ridge, allowing deep water to move between the divided basins.

At the surface, the anti-cyclonic subtropical gyre turns counter-clockwise. South Atlantic Central Water originates there, Antarctic Intermediate Water forms near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands, and both receive some contribution from the Indian Ocean. North Atlantic Deep Water moves south beneath the thermocline. From the sixteenth through the nineteenth centuries, the Atlantic remained central to the slave trade and the Columbian exchange. Those human movements occurred across a basin already organized by currents, ridges and layered water masses.
simp_chinese:
南大西洋的开阔水域位于非洲与南美洲之间的海盆。进入大洋探索时代以后，这片海洋承载着不断扩张的贸易，也承载着奴隶贩运的暴力。1492年，哥伦布抵达美洲；1498年，瓦斯科·达·伽马绕过好望角驶抵印度；1500年，佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔前往印度的船队被南大西洋环流带到巴西。这些航程开通了联系欧洲、非洲和美洲的路线。

这些航路所在的海盆形成于早白垩世西冈瓦纳裂解。大西洋中脊如今沿南美洲板块与非洲板块的扩张边界延伸，把深海分为东西两半。次级海岭分隔海盆，沃维斯海岭与里奥格兰德海隆阻挡洋流。转换断层切穿主中脊，使深层海水能够在其两侧海盆之间通过。

海面上，反气旋式副热带环流呈逆时针方向。南大西洋中央水在其中形成，南极中层水在德雷克海峡与福克兰群岛附近形成，两者都获得部分印度洋水贡献。北大西洋深层水在温跃层下方向南流动。十六世纪至十九世纪，大西洋始终是奴隶贸易与哥伦布大交换的中心；这些人类迁徙发生在早已由洋流、海岭和分层水团组织起来的海洋上。

english: Southeast of Tristan da Cunha, strong westerlies blow across the South Atlantic. Ships used these winds on eastward voyages towards the Cape of Good Hope. The islands were named after Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha, who reached them in 1506; Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛东南方，强劲西风吹过南大西洋。船只利用这些风向东驶往好望角。群岛以1506年抵达此处的葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚命名；英国于1816年在那里驻扎守备队。

english: Southeast of Tristan da Cunha, westerly winds sweep the southern Atlantic. Ships used them to sail east towards the Cape of Good Hope. Portuguese admiral Tristão da Cunha reached the islands in 1506; Britain stationed a garrison there in 1816 while Napoleon was held on St Helena.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚群岛东南方，西风横扫南大西洋。船只利用这些风向东驶往好望角。葡萄牙海军统帅特里斯陶·达库尼亚于1506年抵达群岛；1816年拿破仑被囚于圣赫勒拿时，英国在群岛驻扎守备队。

english: North of the Discovery Rise, the open South Atlantic approaches the latitudes of the Roaring Forties. Strong westerly winds sweep across these southern waters with little land to interrupt them. Beneath the sea to the south, the Discovery seamounts form a chain of volcanic mountains whose summits remain hidden below the waves.
simp_chinese: 发现隆起以北，开阔的南大西洋接近咆哮西风带的纬度。强劲的西风横扫南方海域，沿途少有陆地阻挡。南面的水下，发现海山群组成一串火山山岳，其峰顶仍隐没在波涛之下。

sources.title: Perez et al 2022 Discovery Smt a5818b7b6e.pdf

english: Far east of South America, a submerged ridge extends south from the vicinity of the Rio Grande Rise. The Konstantinov Ridge runs for hundreds of kilometres beneath the South Atlantic, with its shallowest known point still well below the surface. To the north, the Rio Grande Rise forms a broad barrier of seamounts and escarpments across the ocean floor.
simp_chinese: 南美洲以东遥远的海底，一道水下山脊从格兰德隆起附近向南延伸。康斯坦丁诺夫海岭在南大西洋下绵延数百公里，其已知最浅处仍远在海面之下。北方的格兰德隆起由海山和陡崖组成，在海底形成宽广的屏障。

english: In the Cape Basin west of southern Africa, large eddies carry water away from the Agulhas Current. Some spin off as warm, salty rings and travel west across the South Atlantic, exchanging water with their surroundings. Their influence can extend deep below the surface, while colder subantarctic water moves through the basin as part of a different circulation.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部以西的开普海盆中，大型涡旋将水团从厄加勒斯洋流带走。一些温暖咸水涡环向西穿越南大西洋，沿途与周围海水交换物质。它们的影响可深入海面之下；较冷的亚南极海水则以另一套环流穿过海盆。

english: Southwest of the Cape of Good Hope, warm eddies from the Agulhas Current enter the South Atlantic. Some travel northwest through the Cape Basin, while other eddies move west and south across their path. In this meeting place of currents, water originating in the Indian Ocean mixes into the Atlantic circulation.
simp_chinese: 好望角西南方，来自阿古拉斯洋流的暖水涡旋进入南大西洋。一些涡旋向西北穿过开普海盆，另一些则向西或向南移动，与它们的路径交错。在这片洋流交汇的海域，源自印度洋的海水混入大西洋环流。

english: West of the Cape of Good Hope, the Cape Basin receives water from the Indian Ocean as well as the Atlantic. The Agulhas Current turns back near southern Africa, shedding great rings of warm water that drift northwest across the basin. These rings mingle with smaller eddies along the African continental slope, making the waters beyond the Cape unusually turbulent.
simp_chinese: 好望角以西的开普海盆既接纳大西洋海水，也接纳来自印度洋的水。阿古拉斯洋流在非洲南端附近折返时，分离出巨大的暖水环流，向西北穿过海盆。这些环流与非洲大陆坡附近较小的涡旋交织，使好望角外的水域格外动荡。

english: Far west of Gough Island, the Zapiola Seamount rises from the South Atlantic floor without breaking the surface. It forms part of a complex of submarine mountains south of the Rio Grande Rise, a broad feature extending eastward from the Brazilian margin. Above this hidden landscape lie the deep waters of the open Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 戈夫岛以西遥远的南大西洋海底，萨皮奥拉海山拔地而起，却没有露出水面。它属于格兰德隆起以南的海山群；这片宽阔的隆起从巴西大陆边缘向东延伸。隐没的山岳之上，是开阔大西洋的深水。

english: West of Tristan da Cunha, the Pigeon Ground was a stretch of open South Atlantic frequented by southern right whales. American whalers extended their cruises towards the Tristan grounds around 1829 and 1830, finding whales in abundance. Ships returning in 1831 and 1832 brought full cargoes of oil after voyages lasting seven to nine months.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚以西的皮金渔场，是南露脊鲸经常出没的一片开阔南大西洋水域。约在1829至1830年，美国捕鲸船将航程扩展到特里斯坦渔场，发现了大量鲸鱼。1831和1832年归来的船只经过七至九个月的航程，带回满载的鲸油。

english: West of Tristan da Cunha, open water lies on the long passage from Cape Horn towards the Cape of Good Hope. In May 1788 William Bligh searched for Tristan on that voyage, sailing east near the island's supposed position. He saw no land and resumed his course for the Cape, noting how widely the charts disagreed over Tristan's longitude.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚以西，是从合恩角驶向好望角的漫长航程所经的开阔水域。1788年5月，威廉·布莱在这段航程中寻找特里斯坦，沿海图所示位置附近向东航行。他没有望见陆地，便继续驶向好望角，并记下各张海图对特里斯坦经度的巨大分歧。

sources.title: 1792 - Bligh - A voyage to the South sea.htm

english: South of St Paul's Rocks, the equatorial Atlantic holds a tiny outcrop rising abruptly from deep water. In February 1832 the Beagle stopped at the rocks on its voyage from the Cape Verde Islands. Charles Darwin landed with a party from the ship and observed the seabirds crowded onto the bare stone, as well as the mineral crust formed from their droppings.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岩礁以南，赤道大西洋的深水中突起着一小片岩石，距离南美海岸数百英里。1832年2月，“贝格尔”号从佛得角群岛航行途中在礁石旁停留。查尔斯·达尔文随船员登岸，观察了挤满裸岩的海鸟，以及鸟粪经雨水和海浪作用形成的矿物外壳。

english: East of the Brazilian oceanic islands, currents cross the tropical Atlantic at different depths. The South Equatorial Undercurrent flows east beneath the westward surface flow, drawing some of its water from the deeper parts of the South Equatorial Current. Around four to five degrees south, this hidden return flow forms part of a wider system linking the two sides of the basin.
simp_chinese: 巴西大洋岛屿以东，洋流在不同深度横贯热带大西洋。南赤道潜流在向西的表层水下向东流动，其部分海水来自南赤道洋流的较深层。南纬四至五度附近，这道隐没的回流水流是连接海盆两侧的更大环流体系的一部分。

english: The tropical Atlantic between Africa and Brazil became a route of forced migration. From the seventeenth century, enslaved Africans were taken to Brazil from ports including Loango and Luanda. Salvador, founded in 1549, became Portuguese America's first capital and an important centre of sugar production and the slave trade.
simp_chinese: 非洲与巴西之间的热带大西洋成为强制迁徙的航路。自十七世纪起，被奴役的非洲人从罗安戈和罗安达等港口被运往巴西。1549年建立的萨尔瓦多成为葡属美洲首府，也是制糖业和奴隶贸易的重要中心。

english: South of the equator, the Romanche Fracture Zone crosses the Mid-Atlantic Ridge below the ocean surface. Sailors recorded disturbances in the surrounding sea during the age of sail, including one reported in December 1816. Whether these accounts describe submarine eruptions is uncertain, but they point to the difficulties of interpreting strange events in the remote Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 赤道以南，罗曼什断裂带在海面下横穿大西洋中脊。帆船时代的水手曾记录周边海域的异动，其中一次报告见于1816年12月。这些记载是否描述了水下火山喷发仍不确定，却反映了在遥远的大西洋上解释异常现象的困难。

english: Beneath this equatorial sea, the Chain Fracture Zone breaks the line of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. Its long submarine valley is bordered by steep walls, the southern wall rising higher and more continuously than the northern one. Like the nearby Romanche and St Paul fracture zones, it records the separation of Africa and South America.
simp_chinese: 赤道海域的水下，链状断裂带打断了大西洋中脊的走向。漫长的海底谷地两侧是陡峭的谷壁，南壁比北壁更高，也更连续。它与附近的罗曼什和圣保罗断裂带一样，留下了非洲与南美洲分离的痕迹。

english: Beneath the equatorial Atlantic west of the Gulf of Guinea, deep currents form a layered pattern. Jets close to the equator alternate eastward and westward with depth, while another eastward flow lies around two degrees south. These waters belong to a circulation that carries cold North Atlantic Deep Water south along the American margin and into the ocean interior.
simp_chinese: 几内亚湾以西的赤道大西洋深处，洋流形成层叠的格局。靠近赤道的深海急流随深度交替向东、向西流动，南纬两度附近又有另一道东行水流。这些海水属于一套更广的环流：寒冷的北大西洋深层水沿美洲大陆边缘南下，部分进入大洋内部。

english: South of the equator, the South Equatorial Current carries surface water west across the tropical Atlantic. Near three degrees south, waters of the eastern Atlantic can support abundant microscopic plant life. Beneath the surface, a complex system of currents connects the equatorial ocean with waters that have travelled from the southern subtropics.
simp_chinese: 赤道以南，南赤道暖流将表层海水向西输送，横穿热带大西洋。约在南纬三度，大西洋东部的水域能够孕育丰富的微小浮游植物。海面下复杂的流系将赤道海洋与来自南方副热带的水团连接起来。

english: West of Annobón, the Gulf of Guinea opens into the equatorial Atlantic. Portuguese and Luso-African settlers established themselves on the small volcanic island with enslaved African laborers in the sixteenth century. In 1592 a governor, a schoolmaster and a priest were sent there from São Tomé, another island to the northeast.
simp_chinese: 安诺本岛以西，几内亚湾通向赤道大西洋。16世纪，葡萄牙人与葡非混血定居者带着被奴役的非洲劳工，在这座小火山岛上定居。1592年，一名总督、一名教师和一名神父从东北方的圣多美岛被派往安诺本。

english: Southeast of Fernando de Noronha, the Atlantic surrounds a chain of islands far offshore from Brazil. French, Dutch and British ships called at the archipelago for water, food and timber. After a brief French occupation in 1736, Portugal took possession through Pernambuco in 1737 and began building fortifications on the main island.
simp_chinese: 费尔南多-迪诺罗尼亚群岛东南方，大西洋环绕着远离巴西海岸的一串岛屿。法国、荷兰和英国船只曾在群岛汲水、获取食物和木材。1736年法国人短暂占领群岛后，葡萄牙于次年经由伯南布哥夺取岛屿，并在主岛开始修建防御工事。

english: Between Fernando de Noronha and Ascension, green turtles cross the tropical South Atlantic on a remarkable migration. Females leave feeding grounds off Brazil and travel more than two thousand kilometres to nest on Ascension's sandy shores. Fernando de Noronha and the nearby Rocas Atoll also offer feeding and breeding grounds for turtles in the western Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 费尔南多-迪诺罗尼亚群岛与阿森松岛之间，绿海龟在热带南大西洋上进行漫长的迁徙。雌龟离开巴西近海的觅食地，游过两千多公里，前往阿森松的沙岸产卵。费尔南多-迪诺罗尼亚及附近的罗卡斯环礁也是西大西洋海龟觅食与繁殖的地方。

english: Across the tropical Atlantic, the central branch of the South Equatorial Current flows west towards Brazil. Near the South American margin its waters contribute to currents that follow the coast both north and south. Ascension Island lies southeast of this open-ocean passage, across which green turtles travel between Brazilian feeding grounds and their nesting beaches.
simp_chinese: 横贯热带大西洋，南赤道洋流的中央支流向西流向巴西。接近南美大陆边缘时，它的海水汇入沿海岸分别向北和向南的洋流。阿森松岛位于这片开阔海域的东南方，绿海龟横渡大洋，往返于巴西的觅食地与岛上的产卵沙滩。

english:
The western edge of the southern equatorial Atlantic lies over the floor of an ocean that expanded northward after West Gondwana broke apart in the Early Cretaceous. The coastlines of South America and Africa once fitted closely together, although later reconstructions require deformation zones and intracontinental rifts to explain the breakup. In the equatorial segment, magnetic anomalies cannot be used for dating as reliably as elsewhere, so the opening of the Equatorial Atlantic Gateway is estimated at roughly 120 to 96 million years ago.

That final phase of separation also coincided with, or contributed to, the end of continental extension in Africa. Below the warm surface in that period, the Mid-Atlantic Ridge marks the boundary where the South American and African plates diverge, producing volcanic rock and new ocean floor.

Most of this long submarine range lies below water, and its rift valley exposes the structure of the spreading system. At the equator, fracture zones interrupt the ridge and create passages that influence the exchange of deep water. The tropical ocean above therefore combines a relatively young human geography of transatlantic travel with a far older record of continental rupture, volcanism, and the gradual establishment of a deep oceanic corridor.
simp_chinese:
南赤道大西洋西侧的海域，铺展在一片在早白垩纪随西冈瓦纳解体而向北扩张的大洋海底之上。南美洲与非洲的海岸线曾彼此吻合，但后来的重建研究需要加入变形带与陆内裂谷，才能解释这一分裂过程。赤道段缺少可用于可靠定年的磁异常，因此赤道大西洋门户的开启通常估计在约1.2亿至9600万年前。

这一分裂的最后阶段，也与非洲大陆伸展作用的结束同时发生，或推动了其终结。如今温暖海水之下，大西洋中脊标示着南美洲板块与非洲板块相互分离的界线，并不断形成火山岩与新的洋壳。

这条漫长的海底山脉大部分没入水中，其裂谷则显露扩张系统的结构。靠近赤道处，断裂带切过中脊，形成影响深层海水交换的通道。海面上方的跨大西洋航行属于较晚近的人类历史，而海面之下保存着大陆破裂、火山活动与深洋通道逐步形成的更古老记录。

english: Northwest of Ascension Island, the tropical Atlantic is crossed by green turtles travelling from feeding grounds off Brazil. They come ashore to nest on Ascension's sandy beaches, including Long Beach. In 1725 the Dutch East India Company marooned Leendert Hasenbosch on the island; he camped near Long Beach and watched the sea for passing ships, but only his diary was later found.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛西北方的热带大西洋，是绿海龟从巴西近海觅食地迁徙的水域。海龟来到阿森松的沙滩产卵，长滩便是其中一处。1725年，荷兰东印度公司将伦德特·哈森博斯奇遗弃在岛上；他在长滩附近扎营，守望过往船只，后来人们只找到了他的日记。

english: North of Ascension Island, a ship returning from the Indian Ocean might pass the island on its way into the tropical Atlantic. William Dampier's Roebuck sank at Ascension in February 1701 after two years at sea. Dampier and his crew remained stranded for five weeks until an East India Company ship found them and carried them home.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛以北，从印度洋返航的船只驶入热带大西洋时可能经过这座岛。1701年2月，在海上航行两年后，威廉·丹皮尔的“狍”号在阿森松沉没。丹皮尔和船员被困了五周，直到一艘东印度公司船只发现他们并将他们带回家。

english: South of the equator, the Atlantic's currents change direction with depth. The central South Equatorial Current carries surface water westward towards Brazil, while the South Equatorial Undercurrent flows east below it. Near five degrees south, still deeper water can remain in a small area for long periods.
simp_chinese: 赤道以南，大西洋的水流随深度改变方向。南赤道洋流中央支流将表层水向西带往巴西，南赤道潜流则在下方东行。南纬五度附近，更深处的海水有时会在一小片区域停留很长时间。

english: South of the equator in the eastern Atlantic, the South Equatorial Undercurrent carries water eastward below the surface. Its flow brings oxygenated water from the western side of the basin towards the Gulf of Guinea. This undercurrent forms part of a system of narrow flows on either side of the equator, beneath the westward surface currents.
simp_chinese: 大西洋东部赤道以南，南赤道潜流在海面下将海水向东输送。这道水流把富含氧气的海水从海盆西侧带向几内亚湾。它是赤道两侧一系列狭窄水流的一部分，位于向西流动的表层洋流之下。

english: South of the equator, the eastern Atlantic deepens towards the Angola Basin. To the northeast, an isolated seamount rises from the ocean floor to within about 150 metres of the surface. Above the surrounding depths, the South Equatorial Undercurrent carries water eastward towards Africa beneath the surface currents.
simp_chinese: 赤道以南，大西洋东部向安哥拉海盆深处延伸。东北方的一座孤立海山从海床升起，山顶距海面约150米。周围的深水上方，南赤道潜流位于表层洋流之下，将海水向东带往非洲。

english: Southwest of São Tomé, the Gulf of Guinea gives way to the open Atlantic. The island's sugar plantations depended on enslaved labor, but their workers resisted: in 1595 Amador led a major revolt against Portuguese rule. People who escaped the plantations also sought refuge in São Tomé's inaccessible interior, where communities of fugitives took root.
simp_chinese: 圣多美岛西南方，几内亚湾逐渐融入开阔的大西洋。岛上的甘蔗种植园依赖被奴役者的劳动，但劳工也奋起反抗：1595年，阿马多尔领导了一场反对葡萄牙统治的大起义。逃离种植园的人还在圣多美难以抵达的内陆寻求庇护，建立了逃亡者的聚落。

english:
The southern equatorial waters sit within the warm tropical reach of the Atlantic, where large circulating systems move water across regional boundaries. Farther south, the South Atlantic is dominated by an anticyclonic subtropical gyre, and its surface waters travel in a counter-clockwise direction under the influence of winds and the Coriolis effect. The northern side of this system draws from the tropics and eventually passes water toward the subtropics and higher latitudes.

That broad circulation joins waters of different origins. South Atlantic Central Water forms within the subtropical gyre, while Antarctic Intermediate Water comes from the upper layers of the circumpolar region near the Drake Passage and the Falkland Islands. Below the thermocline, North Atlantic Deep Water moves south through the same basin. These pathways create a layered ocean in which warm surface water, fresher intermediate water, and dense deep water coexist.

Mariners encountered the system through winds and currents that could speed a voyage or drive it away from its intended course. The circulation also carried heat, salt, oxygen, and nutrients between the tropics and the far south, making the region part of a much wider Atlantic network. The water masses remain distinct even where their routes lie close together.
simp_chinese:
南赤道水域位于大西洋温暖的热带部分，大型循环系统在这一带跨过区域界线搬运海水。再向南，南大西洋以反气旋型副热带环流为主导，表层水受风和科里奥利效应影响而呈逆时针运动。该系统的北侧从热带取得海水，并最终把一部分水体送往副热带与较高纬度。

这一广阔循环汇合了由来不同的水团。南大西洋中央水形成于副热带环流，而南极中层水来自德雷克海峡与福克兰群岛附近寒带环流的表层。温跃层下方，北大西洋深层水又向南穿过同一海盆。这些路径构成一个分层海洋，温暖表层水、较淡的中间水和致密深层水在其中并存。

航海者通过风和洋流感受这一系统，它既能加快航程，也可能把船只推离预定方向。环流还在热带与遥远南方之间输送热量、盐分、氧气和营养物，使这里成为整个大西洋网络的一部分。即使不同水团的路径彼此接近，它们的性质仍然保持区别。

english: Off Brazil's Atlantic coast, ships arrived after crossing from Africa with enslaved people carried by force. Ports of departure included Loango and Luanda. Salvador, founded in 1549 farther north, became Portuguese America's first capital and a major centre of sugar production and the slave trade.
simp_chinese: 巴西大西洋海岸外，船只从非洲横渡而来，强制运送被奴役者。出发港包括罗安戈和罗安达。更北方的萨尔瓦多于1549年建立，成为葡属美洲首府，也是制糖业和奴隶贸易的重要中心。

english:
The equatorial current region lies between continents that once formed part of West Gondwana. During the Early Cretaceous, South America and Africa began to separate and the South Atlantic took shape. The apparent fit of their coastlines was noticed on early maps and later examined by computer-assisted tectonic reconstructions, although detailed models then include shoreline deformation and internal rifting.

Seafloor spreading propagated northward through several geological segments before reaching the equator. The equatorial segment represents the final phase of this breakup in the South Atlantic. Because the region lies at the equator, magnetic anomalies are poor tools for dating it, but estimates place the opening of the Equatorial Atlantic Gateway between roughly 120 and 96 million years ago. The event also coincided with the end of continental extension in Africa.

The later tropical waters therefore conceal a complex record of rifted margins, fractured ocean floor, and slowly changing deep-water connections. What appears as a single band of warm ocean is underlain by one of the Atlantic's later tectonic openings. The ancient gateway therefore remains visible in the geometry of the later ocean floor.
simp_chinese:
赤道洋流区域位于两块曾共同属于西冈瓦纳的大陆之间。早白垩纪，南美洲与非洲开始分离，南大西洋随之形成。早期地图已经注意到两洲海岸线的契合，后来的计算机辅助构造重建也对此作了研究；不过更详细的模型还须考虑沿岸变形与陆内裂谷。

海底扩张从南部各个地质段逐步向北推进，最终抵达赤道。在南大西洋的这一部分，赤道段构成大陆分裂的最后阶段。由于该区位于赤道附近，磁异常难以用于可靠定年，但赤道大西洋门户的开启通常估计在约1.2亿至9600万年前。这一事件也与非洲大陆伸展作用的结束同时发生。

因此，今日的热带海水之下保存着大陆边缘张裂、海底破碎以及深水连接逐渐改变的复杂记录。看似连续的一片温暖海洋，其底部却对应着大西洋较晚开启的一处构造门户。因此，古老门户的遗迹仍能从后世海底的几何结构中辨认出来。

english: East of Brazil, the tropical Atlantic became a route of forced migration from Africa. Enslaved people were carried from ports including Loango and Luanda. Salvador, founded in 1549 on the Brazilian coast, became Portuguese America's first capital and a major centre of sugar production and the slave trade.
simp_chinese: 巴西以东的热带大西洋成为从非洲出发的强制迁徙航路。被奴役者从罗安戈和罗安达等港口被运来。1549年建立于巴西海岸的萨尔瓦多成为葡属美洲首府，也是制糖业和奴隶贸易的重要中心。

english: Beneath the equatorial Atlantic, the Romanche Fracture Zone cuts across the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. Sailors reported a disturbance near this part of the ocean floor in 1761, one of several accounts of turbulent water in the region. The reports span a wide area, and their possible connection with submarine volcanoes has prompted differing interpretations.
simp_chinese: 赤道大西洋的水下，罗曼什断裂带横切大西洋中脊。1761年，水手报告这片海底附近出现异动；这一地区还有其他关于水流翻腾的记载。这些报告分布范围很广，它们是否与海底火山有关，引出了不同的解释。

english:
Tropical Atlantic waters receive intense solar energy, warming a broad upper layer that can exceed 30 degrees Celsius. This tropical heat contrasts with the polar Atlantic, where surface temperatures may fall below minus 2 degrees Celsius, and with the cold deep ocean far from direct sunlight. The ocean stores this energy over great distances and releases it slowly through currents and contact with the atmosphere.

South Atlantic Central Water originates within the anticyclonic subtropical gyre, while North Atlantic Deep Water flows south beneath the thermocline. That deep current depends on the high surface salinity of the Atlantic and on density changes in high latitudes. Nearer the surface, winds organize a counter-clockwise gyre, exchange with the Indian Ocean adds another origin of water, and the southern gyre's relatively long residence time allows heat and dissolved substances to spread through the basin.

The equatorial upper ocean is thus a reservoir rather than a fixed sheet of warm water. Its temperature and movement influence tropical rainfall, regional climates, and the physical routes available to mariners. Winds and currents can spread that stored heat far beyond the latitude where it entered the sea.
simp_chinese:
热带大西洋获得强烈太阳辐射，广阔的上层海水可升温至30摄氏度以上。这份热带热量与极地大西洋形成鲜明对照，那里表层温度可能低于零下2摄氏度；阳光无法直接加热的深洋同样寒冷。海洋会把热量储存并搬运到遥远地区，再通过洋流及与大气接触逐渐释放。

南大西洋中央水形成于反气旋型副热带环流，北大西洋深层水则在温跃层下方南流。这条深层水流依赖大西洋表层较高的盐度以及高纬地区的密度变化。

更靠近海面的地方，风塑造出逆时针环流，与印度洋的交换增加了又一水团由来，而南侧环流较长的滞留时间使热量和溶解物质能够在海盆内扩散。赤道上层海水因此更像一座不断流动的热量储库，而非固定的暖水薄层；它的温度与运动影响热带降雨、区域气候，也决定航海者可以利用的物理路线。风和洋流可以把储存的热量带离它进入海洋时所处的纬度。

english: West of Ascension Island, ships crossing the South Atlantic could find a remote naval station between Africa and Brazil. Britain garrisoned Ascension in 1815, when Napoleon was held on St Helena. By 1821 the island supplied ships of the West Africa Squadron, which sought to suppress the slave trade; turtles provided fresh meat for the garrison.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛以西，横越南大西洋的船只可以在非洲与巴西之间找到一处偏远的海军驻地。1815年拿破仑被囚于圣赫勒拿时，英国在阿森松驻军。到1821年，岛屿已为致力于取缔奴隶贸易的西非分舰队船只提供补给；海龟则为驻军提供鲜肉。

english:
The southern tropical current region links the equatorial Atlantic to the subtropical and higher-latitude ocean. Its upper waters participate in the anticyclonic South Atlantic Gyre, a warm counter-clockwise system that dominates the basin. South Atlantic Central Water forms within this gyre, receiving some contribution from the Indian Ocean and spreading the properties of the subtropical surface ocean into neighboring regions.

Far below, North Atlantic Deep Water continues south beneath the thermocline. This deep flow carries cold, dense water formed in the north across the equator and through the southern basin, where it encounters Antarctic water masses and seabed ridges. The surface and deep currents do not carry the same water in the same direction, giving the South Atlantic a strongly layered circulation. Wind-driven upwelling and exchange with the Indian Ocean further modify the upper ocean.

The result is a basin that redistributes heat and salt between hemispheres across a wide range of depths. Its tropical waters are connected to cold northern origins and to the Southern Ocean even when the visible surface suggests a uniform warm expanse. This arrangement makes the South Atlantic a key passage for water moving between hemispheres.
simp_chinese:
南热带洋流区把赤道大西洋同副热带及更高纬度海洋连接起来。上层水体参与反气旋型南大西洋环流，这一温暖的逆时针系统主导整个南部海盆。南大西洋中央水在环流中形成，并得到印度洋的部分补给，把副热带表层海水的性质带向邻近区域。

更深的地方，北大西洋深层水在温跃层下方继续南流。这股致密冷水在北方形成，穿过赤道进入南部海盆，并在这里遇到南极水团和海底海岭。表层与深层水流并不以同一方向搬运相同水体，使南大西洋形成层次鲜明的环流结构。

风驱动的上升流和与印度洋的交换继续改变上层海水。其结果是，这个海盆在多种深度上重新分配南北半球之间的热量与盐分；即使海面看似均匀温暖，热带海水仍与北方冷水源以及南大洋保持着深层联系。这种结构使南大西洋成为南北半球之间水体迁移的重要通道。

english: West of the Angola Basin, the tropical Atlantic contains an eastward undercurrent south of the equator. Its waters travel beneath the surface towards the African side of the ocean, carrying oxygen into deeper layers. Farther east lies the Angola Gyre, a circulation extending offshore from the coast of central Africa.
simp_chinese: 安哥拉海盆以西的热带大西洋，赤道以南有一道向东的潜流。它在海面下流向大洋的非洲一侧，将氧气带入较深的水层。更东面是安哥拉环流，从中非海岸向外海延伸。

english:
The equatorial Atlantic gateway opened during the final phase of the breakup between South America and Africa. West Gondwana separated in the Early Cretaceous, and seafloor spreading moved north through the southern and central parts before reaching the equatorial segment. Estimates place the gateway's opening at roughly 120 to 96 million years ago.

Dating is difficult because magnetic anomalies at the equator are less useful, but the event coincided with, or helped end, continental extension in Africa. The later warm waters then move above that long-lived rift system. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge marks the divergent boundary between the South American and African plates, with transform faults breaking its continuity. The equatorial segment lies between about 10 degrees north and the Romanche fracture zone, separating it from the central segment farther south.

Deep-water connections altered as the continental barrier disappeared, and the ocean gradually assumed its present broad intercontinental form. The seafloor preserves traces of volcanic spreading, fracture zones, and basin development beneath the tropical route then followed by ships and surface currents. Over geological time, that opening helped establish the deep connections of the later Atlantic.
simp_chinese:
赤道大西洋门户在南美洲与非洲分裂的最后阶段开启。早白垩纪，西冈瓦纳开始解体，海底扩张从南段、中段逐步向北推进，最终进入赤道段。门户开启通常估计在约1.2亿至9600万年前。

由于赤道附近磁异常难以用于定年，这一时限仍有不确定性；不过该事件与非洲大陆伸展作用的结束同时发生，也可能推动了其终结。后世温暖海水如今在这套长期演化的裂离系统上方流动。大西洋中脊标示南美洲板块与非洲板块的扩张边界，转换断层则切断了山脊的连续性。赤道段大致位于北纬10度与罗曼什断裂带之间，向南与中段分开。

随着大陆屏障消失，深水连接逐渐改变，海洋也慢慢形成今日横亘两洲之间的广阔形态。热带航线和表层洋流经过的海底，保存着火山扩张、断裂活动与海盆演化的遗存。随着地质时间推移，这处门户帮助建立了后世大西洋的深水联系。

english: West of the African coast, the sea connects the Gulf of Guinea with São Tomé and the Atlantic crossing to Brazil. Ships brought enslaved people to São Tomé from the Kongo and Angola during the sixteenth century, while others carried captives onward to Spanish America. After the island's sugar production declined in the seventeenth century, São Tomé remained a port of call for commerce between Africa and Brazil.
simp_chinese: 非洲海岸以西的海域连接几内亚湾、圣多美岛与通往巴西的横洋航路。16世纪，船只从刚果和安哥拉将被奴役者运到圣多美，另有船只将俘虏继续运往西属美洲。17世纪岛上制糖业衰落后，圣多美仍是非洲与巴西之间贸易船只的停靠地。

english: South of the Gulf of Guinea, these waters open towards São Tomé and the coast of central Africa. By the early sixteenth century São Tomé linked Elmina's trade in gold and enslaved people with an expanding sugar economy. The island's cane fields were recorded in 1506, and planters brought increasing numbers of enslaved Africans from Benin, Kongo and Angola to work them.
simp_chinese: 几内亚湾以南，这片海域通向圣多美岛与中非海岸。16世纪初，圣多美将埃尔米纳的黄金和奴隶贸易与不断扩张的制糖经济联系起来。岛上的甘蔗田在1506年已有记载，种植园主从贝宁、刚果和安哥拉运来越来越多被奴役的非洲人劳作。

english: East of Brazil, the tropical Atlantic became a route of forced migration from Africa. Enslaved people were carried from ports including Loango and Luanda. Salvador, founded on the Brazilian coast in 1549, became Portuguese America's first capital and a major centre of sugar production and the slave trade.
simp_chinese: 巴西以东的热带大西洋成为从非洲出发的强制迁徙航路。被奴役者从罗安戈和罗安达等港口被运来。1549年建立于巴西海岸的萨尔瓦多成为葡属美洲首府，也是制糖业和奴隶贸易的重要中心。

english: Between Angola and Brazil, the South Atlantic became a passage of forced migration. Ships carried enslaved Africans from Luanda to Brazilian ports across the ocean. In 1817 the Vigilante Africano, under José Gomes de Amorim, brought 374 captives from Luanda to Bahia; its voyage was one of many that bound the two shores through the slave trade.
simp_chinese: 安哥拉与巴西之间的南大西洋，曾是强制迁徙的通道。船只将被奴役的非洲人从罗安达横渡大洋，运往巴西港口。1817年，若泽·戈麦斯·德阿莫林指挥的“非洲警戒”号从罗安达运送374名被掳者抵达巴伊亚；这样的航程不计其数，通过奴隶贸易将两岸联系起来。

english: Northwest of Ascension Island, the tropical Atlantic surrounds a dry volcanic outpost. Fresh water was scarce on Ascension when a British garrison arrived in 1815, but springs on the mountain helped sustain a settlement. In 1836 Charles Darwin visited the island and saw gardens maintained by the Royal Marines to provide fruit and vegetables.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛西北方，热带大西洋环绕着一座干燥的火山岛。1815年英国驻军抵达时，岛上淡水稀缺，但山上的泉水帮助维持了定居点。1836年查尔斯·达尔文到访时，看到了皇家海军陆战队种植果蔬的园地。

english: Near the equator, the Chain Fracture Zone offsets the Mid-Atlantic Ridge beneath the open sea. Its neighboring Romanche Fracture Zone was associated with reports of unusual disturbances from passing ships. In 1836 material described as volcanic ash was collected floating near the ridge to the east, although the cause of the reported activity is uncertain.
simp_chinese: 赤道附近，开阔海面下的链状断裂带使大西洋中脊发生错移。过往船只曾在邻近的罗曼什断裂带附近记下异常的海面扰动。1836年，航海者在中脊更东处收集到漂浮的物质，将其描述为火山灰；这些活动的成因尚不能确定。

english: East of Ascension Island, a fracture zone cuts across the submerged Mid-Atlantic Ridge. The volcanic island stands west of the ridge between the Ascension and Bode Verde fracture zones, amid a broad region of underwater relief. Above these hidden features, the tropical South Atlantic stretches towards Africa.
simp_chinese: 阿森松岛以东，一道断裂带横切水下的大西洋中脊。这座火山岛位于中脊以西、阿森松断裂带与博德韦德断裂带之间，周围是一片起伏的水下地形。隐没的地貌之上，热带南大西洋向非洲延伸。

english: Along the equator west of the Gulf of Guinea, a tongue of cooler surface water spreads into the Atlantic during the northern summer. Near ten degrees west, the cooling coincides with a seasonal increase in microscopic marine plants. Easterly winds and rising water from below help shape this narrow band amid the warmer tropical ocean.
simp_chinese: 几内亚湾以西的赤道海域，每逢北半球夏季，一条较冷的表层水带向大西洋伸展。在西经十度附近，海面降温伴随着微小海洋植物的季节性增长。东风和下层海水的上涌共同塑造了这条夹在温暖热带海洋中的狭长水带。

english: West of the Gulf of Guinea, cold bottom water reaches the eastern Atlantic through gaps in the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. The Romanche Fracture Zone, far beneath the equator, provides a deep route from the Brazil Basin towards the Guinea and Angola basins. Its valleys descend to depths of several kilometres, concealed beneath the tropical surface.
simp_chinese: 几内亚湾以西，寒冷的底层海水穿过大西洋中脊的缺口，进入大洋东部。赤道深处的罗曼什断裂带为海水提供了一条从巴西海盆通向几内亚海盆和安哥拉海盆的深水通道。它的谷地深达数公里，隐没在热带海面之下。

english: West of the Gulf of Guinea, the waters at the equator move in opposing directions at different depths. Trade winds drive the surface westward, while the cooler Equatorial Undercurrent flows east beneath it. In the northern summer, a band of cooler water extends from the African side of the Atlantic along the equator.
simp_chinese: 几内亚湾以西的赤道海域，不同深度的海水向相反方向流动。信风驱使表层海水向西，而较冷的赤道潜流在其下方东行。北半球夏季，一条较冷的水带从大西洋非洲一侧沿赤道向西延伸。

english: The equatorial waters leading into the Gulf of Guinea form part of the range of the Atlantic yellowfin tuna. Schools gather in the eastern tropical Atlantic to spawn between January and March; some then move west across the ocean. Young tuna are more often found nearer the coasts, while larger fish range farther offshore.
simp_chinese: 通往几内亚湾的赤道水域，是大西洋黄鳍金枪鱼的活动范围之一。鱼群在一月至三月聚集于热带大西洋东部产卵，部分鱼随后向西横渡大洋。幼鱼较常出现在近岸水域，较大的鱼则游至更远的外海。

english: East of Fernando de Noronha, the tropical Atlantic surrounds the peaks of a submerged chain off Brazil. On 20 February 1832 the Beagle stopped at the archipelago, where Charles Darwin observed a steep, columnar volcanic hill during a brief visit. He also recorded flashes of light in the sea near the islands, which the sailors attributed to moving fish.
simp_chinese: 费尔南多-迪诺罗尼亚群岛以东，热带大西洋环绕着巴西外海一条水下山脉露出水面的峰顶。1832年2月20日，“贝格尔”号在群岛停靠，查尔斯·达尔文短暂登岛时观察了一座陡峭的柱状火山山丘。他还记下附近海水中的闪光，船员们认为那是游动的鱼造成的。

english: Atna’tuu is the Ahtna name for the Copper River, whose waters run from the mountains of southern Alaska to the sea. Its basin is the homeland of the Ahtna, a Northern Dene people whose settlements and seasonal fishing places follow the river and its tributaries. Salmon returning upstream were a vital food, and copper from the interior was worked into tools and ornaments and exchanged with neighbouring peoples. In 1797 the Russian explorer Dmitrii Tarkhanov ascended the river as far as an Ahtna village near the Chitina, seeking the source of the metal.
simp_chinese: 阿特纳图是阿特纳人对铜河的称呼。这条河从阿拉斯加南部群山流向大海，其流域是北方德内族群阿特纳人的家园，聚落和季节性捕鱼地点沿河流及支流分布。洄游的鲑鱼是重要食物，内陆出产的铜则被制成工具与饰物，并同邻近族群交换。1797年，俄国探险者德米特里·塔尔哈诺夫为寻找铜的来源溯河而上，到达奇蒂纳河附近的一座阿特纳村落。

english:
San Pedro Atocpan lies at about 2,500 metres in the volcanic uplands of Milpa Alta, south of the old core of Mexico City. Its Nahuatl name means on fertile soil. The community occupies broken ground between Cuauhtzín volcano and Teuhtli mountain, where springs and small fields supported a rural settlement set apart from the lakeside cities below.

Before the Spanish conquest, cooks here prepared chilmulli, a sauce of ground chiles.
